ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_note is
 note_exist boolean;
 temp_note_ID VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 note_exist := true;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from note_books
 where note_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.note_ID;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 note_exist := false;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if note_exist
 then
 begin
 update note_books
 set note = :ctrl_blk_1.s_note
 where note_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.note_ID;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select notebook_seq.nextval
 into :ctrl_blk_1.note_ID
 from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into note_books
 (note_ID, note)
 values (:ctrl_blk_1.note_ID, :ctrl_blk_1.s_note);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update components
 set note_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.note_ID
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 component_prefix = :ctrl_blk_1.component_prefix;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;
